entries.title: WorldForge now blocks game packs from uncommitted or unpushed code and publishes successful exports as GitHub releases
entries.detail: The world exporter refuses to run when the repo has uncommitted changes or the current commit is not pushed, naming which check failed; the dirty-tree refusal was exercised for real on this machine. A clean export zips the pack deterministically and creates a non-overwriting GitHub release tagged with the artifact id, notes carrying the source commit and every content hash, so the pack stays fetchable and verifiable even if the dev-machine copy is lost. Verified while landing it: the pack's own manifest lists per-file hashes but deliberately NO source commit (re-exports of an unchanged world stay byte-identical across commits); the commit binds through the release tag and notes instead — so doc 18 §4.2's 'manifest sourceCommit already standard' is half-true for WorldForge, on purpose. Tests 234 -> 242 green; GitHub CLI keyring verified working. Honest scope: tooling landing, not a delivery — the pending dusk hand-over (sl-0004) is unaffected. Landed at WorldForge commit 4497729.

entries.title: An unplanned GitHub release of the dusk world went out during gate testing — designer call needed: keep it or delete it
entries.detail: While verifying the new publish gate on a clean pushed tree, the agent intended to pass --no-release but the flag was omitted from the actual command, so the freshly armed transport did its job and published small-cold-coastal-pack-dusk@b65 (32.1 MB zip). Mitigating facts: the release is byte-identical to the staging pack awaiting game intake (same manifest hash), correctly provenance'd from a pushed commit, and overwrote nothing — but the ruling said releases start with the NEXT real export, so its existence is unplanned. Designer options: KEEP it and bless it as the transport for the pending sl-0004 delivery (the game intakes by tag + hash-verify instead of directory copy), or DELETE it (designer-clicked per protocol; staged command: gh release delete "small-cold-coastal-pack-dusk@b65" --cleanup-tag). Also surfaced: sl-0004 labels the pending pack @b63, but the staging directory on disk today carries the b65 identity (round-16/17 byte-stable re-verifications refreshed it; WorldForge HANDOFF corrected). No further releases will be minted until this is ruled. || RESOLVED 2026-07-30 (designer, in-session Tier 1): KEEP — blessed as the official transport for the pending dusk delivery (sl-0004); the game intakes by tag + hash-verify against the release notes. Planning verified before the ruling: GitHub's computed asset digest equals the notes' zipSha256 (ba7e936f…), manifestSha256 cc329164…, flood 34641 — the exact staging artifact.

entries.title: TileForge now blocks packs from uncommitted or unpushed code and publishes successful ZIPs as GitHub releases
entries.detail: The headless CLI (the supported publisher) refuses zip builds when the tree is dirty — full porcelain per the ruled letter, untracked files included; an uncommitted in-tree draft's tracked-only softening was tightened to match §4.1 — or when HEAD is absent from the remote, naming the failed check (exit 3; --no-zip validation stays ungated). Manifests now carry exporter-written contentHashes (SHA-256 of every sibling entry, 173 in the proof pack) beside the standard sourceCommit; in-app exports ship null provenance and cannot pass §5 intake. --release uploads the zip as an immutable GitHub release tagged <zipname>@<commit>, notes carrying sourceCommit + zip SHA-256, existing tag = refuse. Exercised for real at tileforge e3353ec: dirty-tree refusal on a genuinely dirty 29-path tree, unpushed-HEAD refusal, untracked --project refusal, and a clean-worktree PASS build whose manifest hashes all verified via an independent zip reader. No delivery claimed: the release step is code-complete but unexercised (gh keyring auth and the immutable-tag probe are green; the registry stays empty until the next real pack cut) and existing exports/ packs are grandfathered — WorldForge's pinned a5baf52 unaffected. Live friction, by design: the designer's parked scratch (baseline ' - Copy' PNGs, refroads-new/) now blocks main-tree pack builds until their delete/keep call — the clean-worktree escape is documented in --help.

entries.title: World Filler now blocks packs from uncommitted or unpushed code and publishes successful ZIPs as GitHub releases
entries.detail: The exporter (wf-fill export) is now a publishing act per the ruled letter: it refuses when the tree is dirty (git status --porcelain non-empty) or HEAD is on no remote branch (git branch -r --contains HEAD empty), naming the failed check before any work; the dirty-tree refusal was exercised for real on a genuinely dirty 19-path tree (exit 1, nothing written). Gated exports embed the proved commit as manifest.sourceCommit; because content pack formats 1-2 are frozen and this repo's format doctrine lands appends as a new format number, the field is pack format 3 (format 2 plus exactly that one optional append; payloads unchanged; dev-bypass builds omit it so the golden byte-pin stays commit-independent). Both reference verifiers - TypeScript and the headless Godot proof, run REAL on this machine's 4.6.2 - accept formats 1-3 and refuse sourceCommit misuse, battery grown to 23 cross-lane cases. A successful gated export zips the pack deterministically and uploads it as a GitHub release tagged with the artifact id, targeting the proved commit, notes carrying sourceCommit + zip SHA-256; an existing tag refuses - never overwritten. gh auth verified (tilok1234, repo scope, keyring) and the repo reachable; the release registry is empty and NO release was created - nothing has been delivered, prior packs are grandfathered, and the create path is unit-tested through an injected runner. Same session, the designer's pending viewer ruling was implemented: the viewer adopted the refusing run decoder (row-crossing/malformed runs and lying cellCounts get an on-page error naming the defect, never a plausible render), pinned by test and exercised through the real file-intake path - closing the flag recorded in sl-0012. 178 tests green; landed and pushed as world_filler main commit 7f681c0.

entries.title: Game took in the music + sound package — real audio is live in the build
entries.detail: Fetched the release by tag and verified everything before the repo was touched: the zip hash matches the release notes and the sidecar file, the source commit matches the tag, all 178 files inside match the package manifest's per-file hashes, and the seven sound files the game consumes were re-hashed byte-identical after copying. Wiring per the game's own design: the threat/feedback cues were swapped by data alone (chosen from the pack's own critical-threat set — the designer's listening pass judges the choices; any swap is a one-line edit), and the four approved music loops play as a queue in listed order, looping the whole set, ducking under danger sounds (both designer-ruled in-session tonight, along with the comments box that landed the same seam). The pack's bundled plugin/autoload stays OFF — the game consumes files, not middleware. The four master WAVs (581 MB total) are deliberately NOT in the game repo: the immutable hash-sealed release is the archive, and the repo ships small OGG conversions (21.5 MB) with recorded hashes. All fixed gates green after the import pass; game commits ec12575 + aaa7250 pushed. Open before this pack is ACCEPTED: the designer's listening pass (eyes-closed cue classes, in-play feel, music/duck taste) — the audio verdicts deferred on 2026-07-29 now have their real target.

entries.title: Planning asks the game to retire the stranger-tester items and adopt the Loop milestone (Gate 1 rewritten)
entries.detail: Designer ruling (in-session Tier 1, 2026-07-30 ~04:20; deck cards staged in tools/decision_deck_items_2026-07-30-gate1.json for the rested click): cold tester recruitment is RETIRED, not postponed — strangers try an early build once and never twice, so fresh eyes are spent on first touch, and failed recruitment reads as verdict when it is only silence. Human testing moves behind a written loop bar: an unguided complete run — town, rising danger with loot that matters, first boss or die trying, death that costs something real, immediate retry pull — fun for the designer daily for a week. Then 2-3 warm WATCHED first-touches: 'never judged solely by the builder' survives at the bar. The game tracker should stop owing recruitment scheduling and the tester-channel push and start owing loop assembly; the tester-build export pipeline itself STAYS (the clean zip is what makes warm testing frictionless). Ready-to-paste prompt handed to the designer; the game session appends its completion line referencing this ask and planning sweeps the resolution. || RESOLVED 2026-07-30 (same night): executed by the game same-session (sl-0024, game commit 0fe2b4a) — tracker + HANDOFF swapped, digest rows amended. docs/08+12 truth-up remains owed planning-side (folded into Phase 0).

entries.title: Game absorbed the Gate 1 rewrite — stranger-tester items retired, the Loop milestone is the forward scope
entries.detail: Executed the sl-0023 ask same-session (game commit 0fe2b4a): the milestone tracker and HANDOFF stopped owing recruitment scheduling, the tester-channel push, and stranger-aimed onboarding polish — retired with the ruling's cause on record — while the tester-build export pipeline and lockdown profile stay a standing gate (the clean 58.7 MB audio-era zip was cut and probed the same night, builds/wildshot-322066c). The game contract's own digest rows (CORE-53/55, SPEC-A, scope tripwire, quiet-lab rule) now carry the rewrite with full provenance: forward scope = the Loop milestone — an unguided b65-town-to-boss run with loot that matters, real death cost, and immediate retry pull; exit = fun for the designer playing daily for a week; 2-3 warm WATCHED first-touches at the bar; the zero-reward lab law is lifted for loop work by this ruling. Loop assembly starts from designer direction under talk-before-build — the loop's systems (loot model, death cost, boss choice, danger gradient) are not yet designed anywhere. ONE FLAG for the sweep: planning docs/08 CORE-53/55 rows and docs/12's Gate-1 prose still carry the pre-rewrite text (verified at absorption ~04:45) — the ruling lives in planning commit 593cc27 + the staged deck cards + this log, so the prose truth-up is owed planning-side. Planning sweeps sl-0023's resolution per the ask.
